question: An electric fan lists at Rs.265.80 and is sold at a discount of 10%. The shopkeeper gives a further discount of 8% for cash payment. The selling price of the fan, when payment is made in cash, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the multiplying factor method for successive discounts:

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 − D₁)% × (100 − D₂)%

SP = 265.80 × 0.90 × 0.92

SP = 265.80 × 0.828 = 220.0824 ≈ 220.08

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 220.08.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 265.80

First discount (D₁) = 10%

Second cash discount (D₂) = 8%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × [(100 − D₁)/100] × [(100 − D₂)/100]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5145f232662c172c587be32c1ac44702686f8bc0ac444c00b74c6b69cddce1b5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after first discount of 10% = 265.80 × (100 − 10) ÷ 100

⇒ Price after 10% discount = 265.80 × 90 ÷ 100 = 239.22

⇒ Final Selling Price after further 8% discount = 239.22 × (100 − 8) ÷ 100

⇒ Final Selling Price = 239.22 × 92 ÷ 100 = 220.0824

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places, SP = Rs. 220.08

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 220.08.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Single Discount

For two successive discounts of D₁% and D₂%, the single equivalent discount percentage is calculated using the formula: D = D₁ + D₂ − (D₁ × D₂) ÷ 100.

Marked Price (MP) vs Cost Price (CP)

Marked Price is the list price labeled on an item. All trade and cash discounts are exclusively calculated on the Marked Price, whereas profit or loss is calculated on the Cost Price.
